name: Triplets-Benchmark
description: Triplets-Benchmark provides collections of triplet examples (anchor, positive, negative) intended to evaluate models' embedding quality and ranking ability. It measures whether a model ranks the positive example closer to the anchor than the negative, enabling diagnostic evaluation of retrieval and similarity models. The dataset is suitable for benchmarking sentence encoders and contrastive/metric-learning approaches.
reputation: A niche Hugging Face dataset used for embedding/ranking evaluation with modest community visibility.
